title: Oulipoly Terminal Unavailable v1 Extension
description: A native model service is temporarily unavailable. This is distinct from account quota exhaustion and rate limiting, and does not authorize replay or account exhaustion.
$comment: Selected only by host.env.OULIPOLY_HOST_TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE_V1=1 in the current request. Extends the terminal_signal in a launch exit or terminal.classify result; it does not replace envelope validation. Unselected providers must emit their existing nonzero_exit fallback with bounded evidence. The pinned provider/v1 base snapshot is unchanged.
